summary: Confirmed on the park's own amenities page: Reserve Florida booking with an 11-month window (inherited values now entry-scoped), 28 gravel sites with 20/30/50-amp and water, max RV 70 ft, dump station, hot showers, no laundry. Sewer at the site and campground season not stated. Fees ($36 + $7 utility + Monroe County $2.50, read 2026-10-12) left as recorded. AWH's note agrees with the page ('Some campsites have an ocean view. Beach access is available between sites 13 and 15'), left alone.
